name: charades
_: THE ONE DELIBERATE INVERSION of 'the wireframe is the spec'.
charades' wireframe ramp sat one full step off the shipped app's —
wireframe navy-500 (#2a4a85) was app navy-600 — and its own config said
so under a KNOWN DRIFT heading. charades is live, so moving the app would
change a released product's colours; moving the wireframe changes nothing
a user sees. The wireframe moves. This is written down here and on
/design/drift rather than done quietly.
Renames applied: navy-* -> brand-*, gold-* -> accent-*, and the ramps are
now the app's full ten stops rather than the wireframe's six.
crimson and royal were two undocumented ramps in the runtime with no
design source. They are not deleted — they turned out to BE the danger and
info families, so they are folded into danger-*/info-* and stop being
separate ramps. This is a small improvement on the approved plan, which
said to delete them; folding loses nothing and explains what they were.
status values are the app's (success #22c55e, danger #ef4444), consistent
with the wireframe-moves-to-app decision above.
skip is the game's third outcome — got it, passed, skipped. It was
declared in the wireframes and dropped from the runtime, which then
hand-rebuilt it as text-orange-700. Restoring it is part of phase 5.
Rule 01 applies hard here: a player reads the result row in about two
seconds, so no category tint may reuse the skip orange.
